rows.corpus_definition: To stop a fire from burning.
rows.example_en: The team worked hard to put out the fire.

rows.corpus_definition: a torn or worn piece of old cloth
rows.example_en: He wiped his hands on an old rag.

rows.corpus_definition: A metal bar used as part of a track.
rows.example_en: The train stayed on the steel rail.

rows.corpus_definition: A dried grape used in cooking or as a snack.
rows.example_en: I like to add a raisin to my cereal.

rows.corpus_definition: The speed or frequency at which something happens.
rows.example_en: The heart rate of the athlete is very low.

rows.corpus_definition: To arrive at a place after traveling.
rows.example_en: We will reach the hotel by eight.

rows.corpus_definition: To act in a certain way because of something.
rows.example_en: How did he react to the news?

rows.corpus_definition: To speak written words aloud so others can hear.
rows.example_en: Please read out your story to the class.

rows.corpus_definition: the back part of something; also to raise a child or animal
rows.example_en: The soldiers attacked from the rear.

rows.corpus_definition: to say aloud something you have learned and remembered
rows.example_en: The student stood up to recite the poem from memory.
